title: SMOK TFV Mini V2 Sub Ohm Tank
description: SMOK have added to their stunning repertoire of tanks with the TFV Mini V2: a compact, lightweight sub ohm tank that offers immaculate flavour and amazing cloud production. A unique press-top cap makes this a really secure tank and almost completely diminishes the risk of leaking. An increased heating area from the TFV8 Baby Beast allows the Mini V2 to heat up far quicker than its predecessor, generating pure, even flavour that you don’t have to wait around for! The Mini V2 also features an enlarged top-fill cap which makes filling the tank with e-liquid extremely quick and clean. Improved airflow inlets make the V2 capable of producing truly massive clouds which are packed full of amazing, clear flavour. The V2 is compatable with the Smok V2 A1 coils which offer unrivalled vapour production and flavour payoff. The A1 has a large hole inside the coil which is covered in robust mesh to allow for faster, more evenly-distributed heating for a deliciously-satisfying vape every time. Also compatible with the V2 tank is the Smok Baby V2 A2 sub ohm coils which boast an innovate two-hole design. The holes are covered in Cobra mesh which offers increased airflow and huge clouds bursting with pure, rich flavour. The perfect accompaniment to your sub ohm setup. The V2 tank can also be used with the Baby V2 A3 coils which have an innovative triple core. Each of the Smok V series coils contain medical-grade antibacterial cotton which reduces bacteria and promotes a more hygienic vaping experience.
